known_pitfall_claim: The equality on line 0008, which replaces min(f(s),g(s)) with an expression involving evaluations at an unrelated x, is false in general.
pitfall_counterexample: Let the domain be Bool and codomain ℝ. Set s=false, x=true, and define f(false)=g(false)=0 and f(true)=g(true)=2. Then min(f(s),g(s))=min(0,0)=0, while (f(s)+g(x)-|f(x)-g(x)|)/2=(0+2-|2-2|)/2=1.
